verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's docs reference Incidents, Services, and Teams analytics, which the Insights Agent uses for recommendations and conversational insights. On-Call Readiness Reports give a team-filtered view of each responder's on-call readiness, which covers part of on-call health. However, no evidence shows MTTA/MTTR trend dashboards or incident-load reporting for leaders. Missing for 10: explicit MTTA/MTTR trend reporting, incident load/volume analytics documentation, on-call burden/fatigue metrics beyond notification-rule readiness, independent corroboration.
